changes.title: Made for the phone in their hand.
changes.text: The current site is a FrontPage layout with no mobile view, and its secure address shows a certificate warning. The concept opens cleanly on any phone with a tap to call button at the top.

changes.title: Finished bathrooms first.
changes.text: Your shower, tub surround and vanity photos are spread across separate catalog pages. The concept leads with them so homeowners see the result before the specs.

changes.title: Ask for a quote any time.
changes.text: Today quotes start with a phone call or a fax during weekday hours. The concept adds a short quote request that works after 4 pm and on weekends.
